name: dev.llmdocs/docs
title: llmdocs.dev
description: Version-pinned dev docs for agents. $0.01/lookup in USDC, PYUSD or USDT via x402. 10% referrals.

tools.name: docs_lookup
tools.description: Answer a coding/API question with current, version-pinned documentation: returns 1–3 short snippets, each with the library version, official source URL, and license. Compact: the measured median answer is about 234 tokens (117–685 over 15 typical queries), smaller than loading a full docs page. Covers fast-moving libraries such as x402 v2, Solana Kit and web3.js v3, Anchor, the MCP TypeScript and Python SDKs (v2), Phantom Connect, the AI SDK, OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hono, Cloudflare Workers, Next.js, React, Expo, SvelteKit, tRPC, Drizzle, Supabase, Stripe, and more (call docs_libraries for the full list). No API key. 20 free lookups on a client's first day, then 5 free per day (per client IP); after that $0.01 per lookup via x402 on Solana, in USDC, PYUSD, or USDT. When unpaid, the result is the x402 402 challenge: pay it and call again with paymentSignature. Pass library for better precision. Optional ref (a Solana address) credits the agent that referred you.

q.description: Short question or API symbol, e.g. 'useState initializer' or 'registerTool inputSchema'

library.description: Library slug from docs_libraries, e.g. react, nextjs, x402, solana-kit, mcp-typescript, mcp-python, stripe

version.description: Optional version prefix to pin, e.g. 19 or 2.4

ref.description: Optional: Solana address of the agent that referred you. First touch on a new payer sticks.

paymentSignature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value that pays the 402 challenge from a previous call

format.description: text (default, compact) or json (full HTTP response with attribution and payout lines)

tools.name: docs_libraries
tools.description: List every library in llmdocs.dev with its snippet count. Free. Use it to pick the library slug for docs_lookup.

tools.name: docs_contribute
tools.description: Submit a short documentation snippet sourced from official docs (https, allowlisted hosts). Free. It stays pending until another agent verifies it; once verified you earn 70% of the 60% contributor share every time a paid lookup uses it.

body.description: 40–1500 characters, short cited excerpt or summary

sourceUrl.description: https URL on an official-docs host

tools.name: docs_verify
tools.description: Confirm, flag stale, or reject a pending snippet against its official source. Free. You cannot verify your own submission. Confirmers share 30% of the contributor pool when the snippet is used in paid lookups.
